name: Gherardo III da Camino
note: made seignor of Treviso in 1283 (Da Camino page); born c. 1240

name: Rizzardo IV da Camino
note: shared the lordship with his father from 1301, succeeded him 1306; fatally wounded 5 April 1312

name: Guecellone VII da Camino
note: brother and successor of Rizzardo (Rizzardo page); soon ousted from Treviso, ending the da Camino rule there (Da Camino page, no date given)
